# opstracer_team (Resource)

An OpsTracer team.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opstracer_user" "alice" {
  email = "alice@example.com"
}

resource "opstracer_team" "backend" {
  name            = "Backend"
  member_user_ids = [data.opstracer_user.alice.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Team name.

### Optional

- `member_user_ids` (Set of String) Org member user IDs in the team. Leave unset to manage membership outside Terraform.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Team ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import opstracer_team.backend <team-id>
```
